title: A1.1 — Greetings & Introductions
description: Master the fundamentals: greetings, numbers, colors, family vocabulary, and basic introductions.

themes.title: Animals Nature
themes.description: Vocabulary and grammar for talking about animals, nature elements, outdoor spaces, and basic nature-related expressions.

themes.title: City & Directions
themes.description: Navigate any Spanish-speaking city: ask for and give directions, describe places, talk about neighborhoods, and understand maps and signage.

themes.title: Coffee Shop & Ordering
themes.description: Order food and drinks confidently, ask for the bill, understand menus, handle payments, and navigate restaurants, cafés, bars, and bakeries.

themes.title: Daily Routines
themes.description: Master reflexive verbs to describe your daily schedule, learn time-telling expressions, and talk about habits and routines using frequency adverbs and sequence words.

themes.title: Family & People
themes.description: Learn to describe your family tree, introduce family members, talk about relationships, and use possessive adjectives to describe people and things that belong to you.

themes.title: Food & Drink
themes.description: Master food vocabulary, learn to order at restaurants, describe tastes, and talk about meals and preferences.

themes.title: Greetings & Introductions
themes.description: Master the essentials of greeting people, introducing yourself, and handling basic social interactions in Spanish. Learn formal and informal expressions, time-based greetings, and how to ask about someone's well-being.

themes.title: Home & House
themes.description: Learn to describe your home, talk about rooms and furniture, use prepositions of place to describe where things are, and understand your living space in Spanish.

themes.title: Weather & Nature
themes.description: Talk about weather conditions, seasons, natural phenomena, and describe landscapes, climates, and outdoor activities.
